name: Forms and validation engine
purpose: Shared machinery for field state, validation timing, error binding, and submit orchestration per application-spa-REQ-007.
responsibilities: Drive validation timing: on blur first, on change after first failure, full pass on submit.
Bind error text to fields via aria-describedby and manage aria-invalid state.
Render the submit-level error summary with anchor links to each failed field and move focus to it on failed submit.
Apply required-field marking, autocomplete tokens, and inputmode/type attributes from the field definition.
Preserve entered values across failed submits and theme or locale switches; user input is never discarded by the engine.

dependencies.name: Component library
dependencies.description: Form controls come from the library; the engine adds behaviour, not rendering.

tradeoffs: Centralised validation timing means individual forms cannot invent their own interaction grammar, which is precisely the point.
